details.initialDiscoveryCorrection: Kate --startanon daemonizes and exits its launcher; the successful foreground probe uses --block --startanon. KWrite never detaches and does not accept these Kate flags.
limitations: Research validates installed 23.08.5 applications and existing private status-helper submission, not future versions or unpublished App Packages.
SetCursor was checked by successful method return; file and openInput contents were independently read back from the editors.
No UNO-equivalent arbitrary document editing/save contract or Qt action automation was certified.
App Package lifecycle, Manager getConnections integration, Matchbox and IBus acceptance remain future-train gates.
